zh-CN.title: 每一点成长都有回应
items: 获得成长值时立即显示轻量提示
同一次操作的多项奖励会合并展示
重复任务或达到上限时不再打扰

en.title: Every growth point gets noticed
items: A lightweight toast now appears when growth points are earned
Multiple rewards from one action are combined into one update
Repeated or capped tasks stay quietly out of the way
